title: My Sister-in-Law Forged My Signature, Stole My Salon. So I Used A Pet Cam And Took It Back
description: After I poured my $88K nursing pension into a salon, my sister-in-law forged a buy-sell and took a $580K franchise deal, sending me a $2K thank-you basket. A hidden pet camera recorded her bragging, and I used it to win back the salon and all its assets. Now she washes dogs in a blinking 'I Stole from My Sister-in-Law' apron while every collar reads 'Styled by a Con.' #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #PetCamJustice
thumb_text: SHE TOOK MY $88K, A PET CAM TOOK IT BACK
pinned_comment: If your sister-in-law forged your name on a $580K deal and left you with a $2,000 gift basket as a 'thank you,' would you have let the hidden camera do the talking or confronted her the moment you found out? I'd love to hear how you'd handle it, drop your revenge plan in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: MY SISTER-IN-LAW LAUGHED ABOUT STEALING MY SALON
SHE GOT ARRESTED AND LOST EVERY DIME
NOW SHE WEARS THE APRON OF SHAME
